policy: Runnable models in the live local Svemir CLI menu are eligible only inside each provider's reviewed model family. Ollama is restricted to reviewed local chat models; remote and embedding-only models are excluded. Antigravity is restricted to Gemini Flash and does not mix in Claude or GPT aliases. One attempt per five-minute tick; at least 30 minutes between accepted monologues, at most 72 attempts per UTC day and 24 per route family. Failed models cool down; account quota errors also defer sibling models. Every attempt and complete response is retained. No catch-up bursts. Hourly output remains an availability target.
